name: multilingual-llava-bench-in-the-wild
description:
Multilingual LLaVA Bench in the Wild
	


	
		
		Note that this is a copy from https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/multilingual-llava-bench-in-the-wild
	

It was created due to issues in the original repo. It also includes the image features and has a uniform and joined structure.
If you use this dataset, please cite the original authors:
@article{PALO2024,
  title={Palo: A Large Multilingual Multimodal Language Model},
  author={Maaz, Muhammad and Rasheed, Hanoona and Shaker… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/floschne/multilingual-llava-bench-in-the-wild.
reputation: A community-maintained multilingual multimodal benchmark commonly used for evaluating LLaVA-style models and multilingual VQA; moderately adopted in multimodal LLM research.
